title: Subscription
subtitle: Your DaleControl Barber plan: what it includes, how it is billed and your invoices.

hero.cancelScheduled: Cancellation scheduled: the plan stays active until {date}.
hero.stripeError: We could not read your subscription from Stripe right now. The plans below are still available.
hero.notConfigured: Online billing is not connected yet. Contact support to activate your plan.
hero.onlyOwner: Only the barbershop owner can contract, change or cancel the plan.

alerts.pendingBody: Your account is ready. Pick a plan and pay by card: access opens as soon as Stripe confirms the payment (no trial period).
alerts.pastDueTitle: We could not charge your subscription
alerts.pastDueBody: Your card declined the last charge. Update the card or pay the open invoice to restore access; Stripe will keep retrying.
alerts.canceledBody: Your data is still here. Contract a plan whenever you want to get back into the panel.
alerts.overLimitTitle: Your plan has less capacity than what you use today
alerts.overLimitBarbers: You have {used} active barbers and your {plan} plan allows {max}. Nothing is deleted: you just cannot add more barbers until you adjust the team or upgrade.
alerts.overLimitBranches: You have {used} locations and your {plan} plan allows {max}. Nothing is deleted: you just cannot open more locations until you upgrade.
alerts.checkoutCanceled: No charge was made. You can pick a plan whenever you want.
alerts.confirmed: Payment confirmed! Your barbershop is now active.
alerts.confirmSlow: Stripe has not confirmed the payment yet. If you already paid, access will open in a few minutes: do not pay again.
alerts.changeDone: Done: you are now on the {plan} plan.
alerts.changeDoneCharged: Done: you are now on the {plan} plan. We charged your card the difference for the current period.
alerts.cancelDone: Cancellation scheduled. Your plan stays active until {date}.
alerts.cancelDoneNoDate: Cancellation scheduled. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
alerts.resumeDone: Your subscription stays active and will renew normally.

plans.title: Plans
plans.lockedIntervalMonth: Your subscription is monthly: switching plans keeps that cycle.
plans.lockedIntervalYear: Your subscription is yearly: switching plans keeps that cycle.

gate.inactive: Your subscription is not active. Activate or pay your plan under Subscription to continue.
gate.featureLocked: {feature} is not included in your {plan} plan.
gate.featureLockedUpgrade: {feature} is not included in your {plan} plan. Switch to the {required} plan ({price}/month) to use it.
gate.upgradeTo: To add more {noun}, switch to the {plan} plan ({limit}, {price}/month).
gate.noPlanAllows: No plan allows more {noun}; contact support.

change.title: Switch to the {plan} plan
change.upgradeExplain: Only the difference for the days left in your period. Your renewal date does not move; on that date the full period of the new plan is charged.
change.downgradeExplain: Nothing is charged today. The credit for unused time is applied to your next invoice and from your renewal you pay the new plan's price.
change.unavailable: We could not calculate the exact amount. Stripe will charge only the proportional difference for the current period.
change.creditLine: Credit for unused time on your current plan
change.limitsWarning: With the {plan} plan you would be over its limits: {details}. Nothing is deleted, but you will not be able to add more until you adjust.

cancelModal.title: Cancel your subscription?
cancelModal.body: Your plan stays active until {date}; after that the barbershop loses panel access until you subscribe again. Your data is not deleted.
cancelModal.bodyNoDate: Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period; after that the barbershop loses panel access until you subscribe again. Your data is not deleted.

invoices.title: Invoices and charges
invoices.failedBody: These charge attempts failed. Update your card or pay the invoice from its link.

charge.insufficient_funds: Your card reported insufficient funds; try another card.
charge.expired_card: Your card is expired; update it and try again.
charge.incorrect_cvc: The security code does not match.
charge.authentication_required: Your bank asked to authenticate the charge: pay the open invoice from “Update card” and try again.
charge.declined: Your bank declined the charge; check your payment method and try again.

errors.generic: Something failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.alreadySubscribed: You already have an active subscription: switch plans here or pay the open invoice.
errors.notConfigured: Online billing is not connected yet. Contact support.
